summary:
Vitality is an interactive web visualization that brings NASA-ISRO NISAR mission data to life, revealing Earth’s surface transformations through Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery. Unlike optical satellites that are blind at night or through clouds, SAR penetrates atmospheric barriers to track glacial retreat, deforestation, earthquakes, and floods 24/7.

Our platform features a 3D interactive Earth globe built with Three.js, showcasing real Sentinel-1 SAR data from Jakobshavn Glacier, Greenland—demonstrating 37 years of ice loss (1985-2022). Animated statistics reveal the human impact: 3.3mm/year sea level rise, 15% AMOC weakening, and Arctic warming twice the global rate. Through smooth scroll animations, tooltips, and interactive modals, we make complex climate data accessible and compelling.

Vitality proves that radar eyes in space don’t just see—they reveal the urgent story of our changing planet, empowering researchers, educators, and the public to witness climate change in real-time.
details:
Vitality is an interactive web application that transforms complex NASA-ISRO SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite data into an accessible, visually compelling experience. Unlike traditional optical satellites that are rendered useless by clouds, darkness, or smoke, SAR uses radar pulses to image Earth’s surface 24/7 in all weather conditions.

Our platform features a 3D interactive Earth globe built with Three.js and React, allowing users to explore real Sentinel-1 SAR imagery. The centerpiece is a temporal comparison of Jakobshavn Glacier in Greenland, showcasing 37 years of ice retreat (1985-2022) through an intuitive timeline slider. Users witness firsthand how one of the world’s fastest-moving glaciers has lost over 15 kilometers of ice.

Key Features

  • 3D Interactive Globe: Rotating Earth with orbit controls and zoom
  • Timeline Slider: Compare SAR imagery across decades
  • Animated Statistics: Numbers count up on scroll, revealing climate impacts
  • Interactive Tooltips: Hover over data to see sources (NOAA, ESA)
  • Smooth Animations: Professional scroll-triggered fade-in effects
  • Coming Soon Cards: Clickable modals showing 6 planned expansions (Amazon deforestation, earthquakes, floods, volcanoes, urban growth, agriculture)

Technology Stack

Built with modern web technologies: React 18 + Vite for fast development, Three.js with React Three Fiber for 3D rendering, Tailwind CSS for styling, and GSAP for animations. Data sourced from ESA’s Sentinel-1 SAR archive via NASA Earthdata and Alaska Satellite Facility.

Intended Impact

Vitality bridges the gap between scientific data and public understanding. By making SAR data interactive and visually engaging, we empower researchers, educators, students, and the public to witness climate change in real-time. The platform demonstrates that satellite radar doesn’t just see through obstacles—it reveals the urgent story of our changing planet.

Creative Approach

We avoided typical static charts, instead creating an immersive experience with a space-themed color palette (deep navy, ocean blue, cyan), smooth scroll animations, and micro-interactions. The design feels premium and mission-driven, not like a generic data dashboard. Every element—from animated number counters to the bouncing scroll indicator—invites exploration rather than passive viewing.
